caption: The drawing depicts a quilt composed of various patterned and colored fabric pieces arranged in a geometric design. The central vertical strip is filled with a repeating pattern of reddish-brown squares and rectangles with accents of blue, white, and yellow. On each side of this center strip, there are four rows, each containing two large triangle shapes meeting at their points, forming a series of hourglass motifs. The fabric triangles on the left include designs such as diagonal stripes in beige and brown, stylized floral patterns in red and blue on a brownish-red background, and swirled motifs on a similar color base. The right triangles have patterns including stripes of red, brown, and beige, small floral prints on a light tan background, and heart or tulip-like shapes on a reddish base. The whole quilt segment is bordered on the bottom and right sides with a dark brown strip marked with abstract, light-colored motifs. The quilt’s overall palette consists mainly of hues of brown, red, beige, cream, and muted blue, highlighted by various geometric and floral patterns within each fabric section. The background of the drawing is plain, with no additional objects or details present.
title: Patchwork Quilt (Section)
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
